book.name: Mateos
book.title: Ramatua Yesus Tutui Malole Na tuka Mateos susura na

content: Ramatua Yesus nanori-nafada fo bosoꞌ mapaneneoꞌ lahenda
“Emi bosoꞌ mapaneneoꞌ lahenda, fo ela Manetualain bosoꞌ napaneneoꞌ emi.
Emi mararaaꞌ lahenda leoꞌ bea, sona neuꞌ ko Manetualain nararaaꞌ emi leo naꞌ boe. Ma emi uku-sudi lahenda fekeꞌ a sala-sikon leo beaꞌ, sona neuꞌ ko Manetualain uku-sudi emi leo naꞌ boe.

O mahiiꞌ tanda noi lahenda sala-siko aana na, tehuu o sala-siko kabaꞌuina ma, sona o mae salaꞌ ta ria fa. Ria sama leoꞌ o mita afu sopuꞌ esa nai o tia-laim mata na. Sekona te baloꞌ kabaꞌuina a babaa etu o mata ma, tehuu ta mameda maan.
Tao leoꞌ bea, de o maparani dedea mae, ‘Toranooꞌ! Mai fo au kue heni afu ria neme mata ma mai dei.’ Sekona te o ta bisa mita hata-hata esa boeꞌ, huu fo baloꞌ a babaa etu o mata ma.
Ae! O nana tebe lahenda dea-mataꞌ! Afi fo, tuꞌu heni baloꞌ ria neme o mata ma mai dei, besaꞌ ko o bisa mita-dae, fo kue heni afu a neme o toranoo ma mata na mai.

Hihii-nanauꞌ lalao-lalafuꞌ laꞌe-neuꞌ Manetualain, bosoꞌ manori-mafadan neuꞌ mana mamumuluꞌ ara. Huu fo sira nana sama leoꞌ busa maꞌaaꞌ, de neuꞌ ko natafali mai suu emi. Sira boe pakanaaꞌ sama leoꞌ bafi. Maneniko lahenda fee lilo mabeli, sona ana ta tao daleꞌ neu! Huu fo noi namolo-natabuꞌ ana.”
Ramatua Yesus nanori-nafada fo hule-haradoi bosoꞌ namaetun

content.text: Lahenda fo hule raroo neuꞌ Manetualain,

content: Emi dodoo manenin! Maneniko anaꞌ a hule roti, tantu papa na ta feen batu fa, hete?
Do maneniko anaꞌ a hule ikaꞌ, papa na ta feen meke!
Maneniko lahenda tadaluꞌ rupa leoꞌ emi a, mahiiꞌ fee emi ana mara hata malole, tantu emi Papa ma nai nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a fee hata fo emi hule Ni a, huu fo emi Papa ma riꞌ tebe malole a.

De, hata fo o nau lahenda fekeꞌ taon soa-neuꞌ o, sona o muste tao leo naꞌ soneuꞌ ria boe. Huu fo ia nana, huu-pedaꞌ neme basa-basan fo baꞌi Musa no Manetualain mana nesi mata feke nara ranori-rafada memaꞌ neme fai a ulu na mai.”
Ramatua Yesus nanori-nafada laꞌe-neuꞌ lelesu bafa lutuꞌ

“Maneniko lahenda nau masoꞌ nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ, sona ana muste laꞌo nesiꞌ lelesu bafa lutuꞌ a. Huu fo enoꞌ fo mudaꞌ laꞌesaꞌ ma lelesu bafa loaꞌ, riꞌ lahenda dodouꞌ rahiiꞌ resiꞌ ana. Tehuu besa-besa! Huu fo eno leo naꞌ a, riꞌ neni lahenda leo naraka neu, fo ara bika-bati reme Manetualain.

Lahenda fo nau masoꞌ nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a, muste tuka eno susa, ma nesiꞌ lelesu bafa lutuꞌ ria. Huu fo leo mae noi lahenda bai anaꞌ a laꞌo resiꞌ na, tehuu eno bafa lutu leo naꞌ a riꞌ noo lahenda leo Manetualain neu.”
Ramatua Yesus nanori-nafada fo bosoꞌ tuka mapuputaꞌ ara
“Besa-besa mo manatipu-manadaiꞌ fo io ao nara rae, sira nana Manetualain mana nesi matan. Huu fo tao uni sira malole sama leoꞌ bibi-lopo. Sekona te sira tadaluꞌ, sama leoꞌ busa fuiꞌ maꞌaa.
Emi bisa malelaꞌ tao lahenda mana fufudiꞌ sira leoꞌ bea? Mete neme sira nonoi-tataon. Sama leoꞌ lahenda nita ai boaꞌ, fo nalelaꞌ ai boaꞌ ria huu na. Ai boa malole, ta kalua neme ai huuꞌ fo ta malole.
Huu fo ai huu malole neni buna-boa malole. Tehuu ai huu ta malole neni buna-boa ta malole.
Ta hapu ai huu malole neni buna-boa ta malole. Ma ta hapu ai huu ta malole, neni buna-boa malole.
Ai huuꞌ fo ta neni buna-boa malole, tantu ara mai beta henin fo tuꞌun leo ai-pilaꞌ daleꞌ neu.
Leoꞌ na boe soa-neuꞌ mana nesi mata fufudiꞌ ara. Emi bisa malelaꞌ asa neme sira nonoi-tataon mai.”
Ramatua Yesus nafada laꞌe-neuꞌ lahenda fo seseiꞌ Manetualain noi nai bafadoo nara

“Neuꞌ ko lahenda raloo Au rae, ‘Ramatuaꞌ!’ Tehuu ara seseiꞌ noi nai bafadoo nara. Neuꞌ ko Manetualain nai nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a tipa heni si. Noi lahenda fo tuka matetuꞌ Ria hihii-nanaun, riꞌ Ana sipoꞌ asa dadi reuꞌ Ria lahendan.

Neuꞌ ko dae-bafoꞌ a nonoe na, te lahenda dodouꞌ manaku rae, Au ia nana sira Ramatua na. Ara leleꞌo Au rae, ‘Ramatuaꞌ! Ami meu tui-beka Ramatuaꞌ a nanori-nafadam so. Ami boe usi nitu ra pake Ramatuaꞌ a nade Ma. Ma ami tao tanda heran rupaꞌ ara pake Ramatuaꞌ a kuasa Ma.’
Leo mae ara leleꞌo Au laꞌo naroo leoꞌ na boe, tehuu neuꞌ ko Au afada si ae, ‘Emi ia nana bea? Au ta alelaꞌ emi, huu fo emi ta masoda tuka Manetualain hihii-nanaun. De maheoꞌ meme iaꞌ mai leo.’ ”
Ramatua Yesus nanori-nafada laꞌe-neuꞌ lahenda malelaꞌ ma lahenda pakanaaꞌ
“Lahenda fo mai namanene neuꞌ Au, ma tao tuka Au dedea-nafada Ki, ria sama leoꞌ lahenda malelaꞌ a nafoa uma na nai fanderen batu.
Boe ma uda inaꞌ a onda mai losaꞌ faa ra. Ani inaꞌ a boe fae fee uma ria. Tehuu uma ria ta hea neu, nana huu ana napadei nai fanderen batu matea.
Lahenda fo mai namanene neuꞌ Au, tehuu ta tao tuka Au dedea-nafada Ki, ria sama leoꞌ lahenda pakanaaꞌ a nafoa uma na neuꞌ soroaeꞌ lain.
Tepoꞌ fo uda inaꞌ a mai losaꞌ faa ra, ma ani inaꞌ a fae fee uma ria. Boe ma uma ria hea neu losaꞌ nalulutuꞌ.”
Lahenda ra heran ramanene Ramatua Yesus nanori-nafada kahere na
Yesus dedea basa leoꞌ na, boe ma basa lahenda ra heran ramanene Ria nanori-nafadan,
huu fo Ana nalelaꞌ matetuꞌ nanoriꞌ ria isi-liin. Ria eno nanori-nafadan, ta sama no sira mesen agama nara.
